Executive Summary

I used Qwen3-Max (non-thinking) on HW5 coding parts.

A few notes I realized was that
1. Qwen3-Max despite being non-thinking actually responds with well curated chains of thought. It always responds in a step-by-step structure and always double checks its answers.

2. Overall it answered everything very well, with great detailed reasoning traces and explanation. It also ensured quality of its response with double checking its answers. There were many times it changed its response after checking again and realizing it was wrong. 

3. OCR capabilities are great too - it was very good at reading the graph outputs of the assignment.
